operator_ref.description: Stable workspace-local operator identifier for attribution/personalization; does not grant authority.

team_ref.description: Optional team context used for preference resolution; does not grant authority.

role_ref.description: Optional role context used for preference resolution; does not grant authority.

preference_output_type.description: Optional output-type context used only for preference applicability.

preference_channel.description: Optional channel context used only for preference applicability.

preference_snapshot_ref.description: Run-local effective-preference snapshot used for reproducible execution context.

completion_policy_ref.description: Optional reference to the completion-evidence policy snapshot governing this Run.

root_run_id.description: Optional exact root Run for this bounded Run family; newly created root Runs reference themselves. Omission preserves compatibility with Runs created before explicit family relationships existed.

parent_run_id.description: Optional exact parent Run for explicitly related support work.

run_role.description: Explicit role for newly created Runs. Legacy omission is interpreted as support only when parent_run_id exists, otherwise root.

supersedes_run_id.description: Optional exact prior same-job Run intentionally replaced by this Run.
